gen-dafont-gobold-fs-nunito: Wide-set and blunt, Gobold shouts in geometric shapes with curves that never quite close. And Nunito follows in soft sans-serif lowercase, its round bowls and loose terminals making a long paragraph feel friendly rather than loud.
gen-dafont-gobold-fs-public-sans: Gobold looks stamped and stretched, its letters spaced far apart with curves left hanging open. Public Sans is the pair's strongest card, a hefty, trustworthy plain sans whose broad counters keep everything legible beside that loud display face.
gen-dafont-gobold-merriweather: Gobold is all spread-out, wire-straight swagger up top.  Merriweather is the stocky, cozy classic serif below, where Gobold does its best work shouting a few words and Merriweather's soft taper does its best work carrying the sentences.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-alpino: Casual and cozy, Alpino sits below a wide, commanding Good Times heading. The heavy verticals up top lean against Alpino's tall, tightly spaced sans-serif letters, so the page feels sturdy but still relaxed.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-erode: Dignified, in an editorial way, Erode takes the body. Good Times above it is wide and geometric, so keep Erode's size generous enough for its tall middle band and gentle stroke shifts to show.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-ranade: Ranade reads loose and organic, its sans-serif strokes slightly swelling and ending far apart. Groovy's smooth, tube-like heading, with its almost-closed c, gives way to that openness, and the lines flow along with a friendly, funky bounce.
gen-dafont-guttural-fs-asap: Readable and professional, Asap keeps its open arcs and tall lowercase beneath Guttural's dense, brush-pressed heading. Paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-dafont-guttural-fs-epilogue: Guttural comes in dense, tight and brush-pressed. Epilogue, a plain sans with curvy, unclamped letters and a wire-like line, lets a whole paragraph breathe and feel contemporary.
gen-dafont-guttural-fs-supreme: Supreme brings a crisp, heavy-looking band of text. Beneath Guttural's folded, drawn-wire heading, its letters stay held open, so the dense top and the sharp sans below feel like deliberate opposites.
